name: MLT / melt
role: MLT multitrack framework with melt CLI and XML projects; the engine behind Kdenlive and Shotcut
summary: LGPL multimedia framework whose melt CLI plays or renders multitrack timelines from command-line producers, filters and transitions or from an XML project file. Uses FFmpeg for codecs and frei0r or Movit for effects. Distinguishing strength: a mature declarative timeline and compositing model with an XML interchange, driven without a GUI.
use_when: Multitrack edit from an XML project, over hand-written FFmpeg filtergraphs
Opening Kdenlive or Shotcut projects headlessly to render them
Reference for a timeline-to-render contract with tracks, transitions and filters
avoid_when: Simple encode, trim or concat: ffmpeg-ffprobe is simpler and everywhere
Browser-authored scenes: Playwright capture into FFmpeg
Alpha-precise flat-layer compositing VCR controls: FFmpeg overlay filters until VCR's compositor exists
license: LGPL-2.1-or-later for the framework; some modules and plugins are GPL, check the build
notes: 2026-10-26: Homebrew formula name 'mlt' assumed from the record; melt installation was not tested and a Homebrew build includes whatever modules the formula enables.

assessment.rationale: Release v7.42.0 on 2026-10-03 and a push on 2026-10-25; LGPL-2.1; Kdenlive and Shotcut ship on it. Capable but redundant with FFmpeg for VCR's current needs; useful as timeline-model reference.
